messages:
lee: Heads-up: support reported requests billed to Org Zeta when callers used a projectless key from Org Theta. Quick trace shows an `X-Tenant` header mismatch vs key owner. Not widespread but affects some customers after last weeks edge change.

lee: Repro (minimal):
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer projless_zyx" -H "X-Request-ID: r-999" \
  -H "X-Tenant: zeta-company" https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```
Observed: edge responds with `X-Tenant: zeta-company` (from connection) but auth service metadata says owner=theta-corp. Console counts to zeta-company.

oliver: Could be the connection-affinity header rewriting we added for faster routing. If the proxy reuses a keep-alive connection, it might preserve the last-stitched tenant header.

rachel: Confirming: the authz flow used to overwrite X-Tenant after token validation, but the new fast-path skips enrichment in some cases. That would let stale headers through.

lee: Two proposals: (A) always overwrite X-Tenant after auth, authoritative source = token metadata OR key lookup; (B) introduce a dedicated header `X-Auth-Owner` from auth-service and make telemetry prefer it. Which is lower risk?

oliver: A is simpler but requires edge-to-auth sync on every request (adds latency). B is lower-latency but needs pipeline changes to prefer the new header. I favor B for perf-sensitive paths.

rachel: If we go B we must ensure auth-service reliably emits `X-Auth-Owner` for projectless keys and rotated tokens. Also add signing or internal-only header to prevent clients from spoofing. Maybe `X-Internal-Auth-Owner` and edge strips client headers first.

lee: Good point about spoofing. We should strip incoming X-Tenant from clients at the edge before any enrichment. Also set `X-Internal-Auth-Owner` and mark it as internal-only in the proxy.

oliver: Telemetry impact: dashboards will re-attribute some request counts. Need a migration-safe plan: feature-flag `prefer_internal_owner` default off. Canary internal -> sandbox -> broad. We'll emit `attribution_delta_ratio` metric per org during canary.

rachel: QA asks for sampling of conflicting requests. Suggest metric `auth_header_mismatch_sample` that logs up to N example request_ids and the two owner values. Export samples to S3 with 24h TTL.

qa: I'll write the smoke tests: verify that when `prefer_internal_owner` is on, console attribution equals auth-service owner for sampled keys. Also test that clients cannot spoof `X-Internal-Auth-Owner`.

lee: UX: in the console request detail panel show a small badge when observed owner != auth owner: "owner observed: zeta-company | owner asserted: theta-corp" with a link to the sample log. Helps support and customers.

oliver: Implementation plan:
- auth-service: always resolve owner for projectless keys -> set `X-Internal-Auth-Owner`. Add HMAC on header using internal key to prevent spoofing.
- edge proxy: strip client-provided tenant headers, validate HMAC, populate telemetry header `X-Telemetry-Owner` when FF on.
- telemetry: prefer `X-Telemetry-Owner` over `X-Tenant` if present. Add `attribution_conflicts_total` counter and `attribution_delta_ratio` gauge.

rachel: Security note: make sure header HMAC key rotates and we capture rotate events in logs. Also audit log entries for any mismatch with request_id.

lee: Rollout timeline: feature flag canary 5% internal traffic for 6h, check `attribution_conflicts_total` and quota drift. If <0.1% conflicts and no significant quota spikes, promote to 30% sandbox for 24h, then 100% in 48h. Rollback by flipping FF and reverting edge enrichment if needed.

oliver: I'll own the edge changes and FF wiring. Rachel owns auth-service and HMAC. Lee will coordinate console/telemetry changes and PR reviews. QA will validate.

infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary window reserved 2026-03-23 01:00-04:00 UTC. Oncall notified.

qa: Opening test plan doc in a sec and adding smoke test checklist.

lee: Thanks. Also add a small note in platform changelog and ping support so they know to expect console badge and sample links.

oliver: PR opened: https://git.example/redwood/edge/pulls/1428 (edge changes + FF).

rachel: PR opened: https://git.example/redwood/auth/pulls/871 (auth-owner header + HMAC).

lee: Great, let's sync tomorrow at 10am to review metrics and go/no-go. :thumbsup:
